gates.capability_and_exactness: mandatory for every timed C; no performance exemption
gates.kernel_only_triage: >=1.20x vs B is a triage signal, not a requirement
gates.adapter_total_gate: paired median >=1.10x over B on >=1 representative held-out workload, no >3% median regression on another supported guard workload
gates.warm_small_batch_gate: paired median >=1.05x over BOTH A and B on warm small-batch total; cold-first-use guard must show no material regression
gates.below_threshold: keep B/A or experiment only; no optional backend on performance grounds

controls.A: accepted Numba _longwave_primary/_longwave_primary_serial at frozen HEAD, env default
controls.B: same new layout/scheduling in Numba; if C requires a layout change, B implements the identical transformation; bitwise vs A on all fixtures before timing
controls.C: foreign backend kernel matched to the frozen typed graph; adapter boundary includes validation, packing, conversion, invocation, sync, host materialization, fallback calls

fixtures.exactness_set: all 520 captured calls replay bitwise (test_v7_contract_freeze.py) on A; C must match on its admitted subset and reject the rest
fixtures.kernel_only_sizes: B in {4096, 16384, 65536} x P=153, synthetic adversarial blocks (conftest builders, seed 20260922+pixels), both serial-equivalent and parallel-equivalent schedules
fixtures.adapter_sizes: same blocks including validation/decision overhead; packed-decode outputs used as prepared inputs (decoder outside island, per KERNEL_CONTRACT)
fixtures.warm_small_batch: real 35x32 reference scene, 24 records, runtime configs {serial default, threads_per_worker=4 cpu_budget=4}
fixtures.held_out_rule: tuning on 64^2 fixture only; 128^2 and 256^2 + real scene are evaluation/held-out

budgets.development_discrimination: 2 alternating paired repetitions on one dense and one vegetation fixture with matched chronology
budgets.final_small_selection: 3 paired repetitions on held-out small cases
budgets.order: frozen alternating A/C then C/A (and separate B/C), or seeded recorded order

thread_and_resource_policy.process_isolation: T1/T2 are separate processes per runtime/thread configuration
thread_and_resource_policy.pool_query: request pools before import; log requested H, configured max, effective mask/pool, backend selected, device type AFTER init
thread_and_resource_policy.equivalence: equal CPU budgets define fairness, not env var names; 4x2 vs 1x4 are different budgets and labeled as such
thread_and_resource_policy.exclusive_lease: benchmark owner holds exclusive host lease; no other builds/tests/measurement during timed trials on this M1 Pro
thread_and_resource_policy.runtime_fingerprints: numba/llvm/pocl/drjit/ispc versions, ISA (arm64 + NEON/Apple Silicon), math flags recorded per trial
